_meta.description: Roadmap data. Edit via scripts/roadmap_cli.py, not by hand. Run its `render` command afterward to update roadmap.html. Fully local, nothing here is ever pushed anywhere.

milestones.name: Knowledge base
milestones.description: memory/ knowledge base: brief, requirements, research per topic, decisions, open questions.
milestones.why: The project is big; every later session starts from it.

milestones.name: Stack decision
milestones.description: Pick the UI framework and shared core from research/stack.md; user approves; hello-world on Android.
milestones.why: Every other milestone depends on it.

milestones.name: Android reader core
milestones.description: Library, import, EPUB + PDF open, reading position, TOC, single/double page, portrait/landscape.
milestones.why: Android first; the smallest app the user can actually read with.

milestones.name: Flip and page modes
milestones.description: Procedural page curl (default), click zones editor, vertical endless scroll, volume keys + invert.
milestones.why: Flip is the default mode and the hardest piece of the reading view.

milestones.name: Themes and typography
milestones.description: OLED/E-ink/Paper/Parchment/Custom in light+dark, brightness, blur; font browser, custom fonts, text styles, i18n; reflow.

milestones.name: Actual book mode
milestones.description: Okuma-style filters: paper texture, book fold, lighting, side pages, book shadow, behind one toggle.
milestones.why: Signature look; builds on the page renderer.

milestones.name: Image filters and colorize
milestones.description: Upscale, saturation, on-device colorize (on demand + auto with background queue), gallery.
milestones.why: Needs the ML runtime; independent of reading core once images are addressable.

milestones.name: Read aloud
milestones.description: System TTS default, downloadable model catalog, API keys, toggle.
milestones.why: Needs text extraction from the reading core.

milestones.name: All formats
milestones.description: MOBI/AZW3, FB2, CBZ/CBR, DjVu, TXT and the rest of research/formats.md.
milestones.why: EPUB/PDF first; the rest after the core is stable.

milestones.name: In-book search
milestones.description: Search the whole book: a list of hits with a line of context, jump to a hit, EPUB and PDF alike.
milestones.why: Every reader has it and this one does not.

milestones.name: Natural offline voices
milestones.description: Automatic voicing (built, not yet released). Small Turkish voices Antalia-2 Mini and Ahenk Cep. The reader's own voice or a loved one's, cloned on the phone: Supertonic, then OpenVoice v2's converter as int8 ONNX, about 34 MB more.
milestones.why: Natural speech with no internet is the heart of reading aloud; the spike measured RTF about 0.29 on 2 desktop threads.

milestones.name: Audiobook player
milestones.description: A music-player screen: cover for album art, the words being read for lyrics, author for artist, title for song name. Below: about the author and about the book, found online (Wikipedia, Open Library) and kept. Favourites, and listening shelves (like playlists) to save books to. Audiobook files (m4b, mp3) matched to the ebook.
milestones.why: Asked for by the user on 2026-11-13, laid out like Spotify's now-playing screen.

milestones.name: Manga and manhwa
milestones.description: Done: right-to-left (0.1.4), the webtoon strip (0.1.5), panel by panel (0.2.0). Next: two-page spreads, upscaling low-resolution scans on the phone, and finding speech balloons, reading their text and translating it offline.
milestones.why: Asked for by the user on 2026-11-10.

milestones.name: E-ink mode
milestones.description: Builds on the E-ink theme: no animations anywhere, high contrast, a full refresh every few pages, page turns by key or tap only.
milestones.why: Boox and similar readers are where long books are read.

milestones.name: Reliability
milestones.description: Tests that open every older library file on each release, and automatic backups. The library survives a new phone. End-to-end tests that run on the emulator on their own. Measured limits for a large library, a large PDF and an old phone.
milestones.why: The 0.1.8 data-loss bug must never happen again; today the end-to-end checks are done by hand.

milestones.name: iOS and desktop
milestones.description: iOS app, Windows/macOS/Linux apps (Rune if chosen).

milestones.name: Release and site
milestones.description: Public GitHub repo, releases with binaries, egebookreader.vercel.app.
milestones.why: Asked for at the end; each remote step needs approval.

milestones.name: Interface languages
milestones.description: English and Turkish ship first. Then Russian, Arabic, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, German, French, Hindi.
milestones.why: Asked for by the user on 2026-11-10.

notes: Fully local and serverless: no server of our own, ever. The device talks straight to public services (Open Library, Wikipedia), and models download from GitHub releases. The free Vercel site and free Vercel add-ons are the only hosting.
